identity.name: Fortune Website Guide refreshed-corpus multi-turn evaluation

charter.decision: Regrade the frozen August 17 conversations after correcting two demonstrated confirmation-turn artifacts.
charter.unitUnderTest: The same 12 episodes and 50 turns used by versions 2026-08-17.1 and 2026-08-17.2.
hardConstraints: Do not change a turn, episode level, slice, grounding rule, topic-shift rule, source allowlist, no-guessing gate, or participant message.
Clarification authority is graded from offered choice labels and prompts because response.sources is intentionally empty for kind=clarify.
Advancement remains required except for the two declared turns whose questions explicitly request facts already required from the preceding answer.
nonGoals: Change runtime routing, retrieval, prompts, source records, or production behavior.
Waive repetition for any other turn.
Convert substantive context loss, generic clarification, incomplete retrieval, or stale-status failures into passes.
Overwrite the version 1 or version 2 spec, frozen cases, or prior raw runs.

grader_contract.clarification_authority: For kind=clarify, source_match_any and source_excludes inspect choice labels and prompts in addition to response.sources.
grader_contract.advancement_exception: A turn may set advancement_required=false only through this bounded overlay when its expected answer is a direct confirmation of evidence the preceding turn was already required to state.

adjudication.expected_delta_on_v15_raw_result: The source-grounded phone-status confirmation moves the v15 run from 49/50 turns and 11/12 episodes to 50/50 and 12/12. No model response, source requirement, stale-positive exclusion, or frozen participant message changes.
